what: 20 mm 90 deg flanges on all four edges, made together: the corners close with the rule's gap, notch relief
method: T = 2, R = 1, K = 0.5, the corner gap g = 0.5. A bend zone is BA = theta (R + K T) wide in the flat; folded it is an annular sector holding theta T (R + T/2) a mm of bend, T BA with K = 0.5, and every panel moves rigidly, so V = T x the flat area. An edge flange's outer virtual sharp is on the picked edge: the base is cut back s0 = (R + T) tan(theta/2), the bend starts there, and its panel is H - s0 long (H from the sharp along the outer face). Closing a corner (sheet.rs close_corner): every point of a panel's end keeps g/2 from the plane halving the two flanges' inner faces. For the flange on y = 0, its bend along x from the corner (s0, s0), a point s up its panel (rigid, turned theta about the bend axis T + R up) on the face z of the sheet keeps that distance from x = s0 - R sin(theta) - s cos(theta) + g/sqrt2 + (T - z) sin(theta) on; the inner face z = T needs least, so the end is the line x = s0 - e - s cos(theta), e = R sin(theta) - g/sqrt2: the panel runs on e past its bend's end at its foot and a further cos(theta) per mm up it (outward below 90 deg, cut back above). Each panel is the trapezoid leg x (L + 2e + leg cos(theta)), its bend BA x L, L the base's edge less 2 s0 (the bend ends square at the corner). At 90 deg: s0 = 3, BA = pi, leg 17, e = 1 - g/sqrt2 = 0.646447 (the panel ends T + g/sqrt2 short of the other's outer face line, gap g between the inner edges), no slant. Base 94 x 54, bends pi (2 94 + 2 54), panels 17 (2 (94 + 2e) + 2 (54 + 2e)); V = 2 x that = 22251.656329. The walls' outer faces stand on the edges: bbox 100 x 60 x 20. The notch relief cuts nothing: the bends end square at the corners
